transforms.name: normalized-interaction
transforms.effect: Permission or question events are published from the adapter handler.

transforms.name: reduce-blocker
transforms.effect: A pending interaction becomes a blocker. Resolution removes it. Outcome text is not a row wait by itself.

transforms.name: derive-wait
transforms.effect: agentWait copies the first blocker kind, since, and optional tool, question, or detail.
